items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I was working for Taylor's -- Dr. Taylor's in the Dixie Drug Store.

ctx.x: Now, adults have a way of covering up, you know. They don't let you know -- a little child know how bad off they are, see, and I think mother was on the way of dying, but I didn't know. So we got to be buddy-buddy again, so forth, and I stayed home there, stayed in Atlanta until -- I got my job back selling newspapers and dancing on the streets for coins, you know, and make me a little money somehow.
I was working for Taylor's -- Dr. Taylor's in the Dixie Drug Store. That's the job I got, you know, like running errands, delivering prescriptions for old folks and sick people like that. And --
